hero.lede: I lead operations for a national vacation company by day and the Greenwood Christian Academy boys' basketball program by night, and I write about what each one teaches me about the other. The best thing on my resume? My wife, Jess and our three kids.

coach.heading: Building a program
paragraphs: In 2025 I became Head Boys' Basketball Coach at Greenwood Christian Academy. In our first season together, the we won the sectional championship and advanced to the regional round, playing our best basketball when it counted most.

Basketball has shaped my whole life: point guard and senior-year captain at Southport, almost a decade coaching in the Southport program, and founder of IU Film Room, a film-breakdown site for Indiana basketball fans.

timeline.name: Southport Middle School
timeline.role: First head coaching job. Broke the school wins record by year three

timeline.name: IU Film Room
timeline.role: Founded a film-study site covering IU basketball

coach.banner_sub: Greenwood Christian Academy Cougars, first season at the helm

leader.heading: Leadership is leadership
paragraphs: I'm Senior Vice President of Operations at Keyholder Vacations, where I lead the teams and systems behind our guests' vacations. It is the parent company of where I spent six years as President at DVC Rental Store, the largest Disney Vacation Club point-rental broker in the country.

Everything I know about leading people I learned in a gym first: connect before you correct, communicate with clarity and the right tone, mesh different personalities into one culture, and lead every person the way **they** need to be led.

cards.title: Connection first
cards.text: People don't follow titles. They follow leaders who know them, invest in them, and keep an open door.

cards.title: Culture is daily
cards.text: A winning culture doesn't happen by accident. It's built through intentional, consistent action every single day.

cards.title: Empathy + accountability
cards.text: Understanding what someone is going through and holding them to a standard aren't opposites. The best leaders do both.

family.heading: The home team
paragraphs: I met Jess in the summer of 2007, before my junior year of high school, and finally worked up the nerve to ask her out that winter. We married in May 2015. Growing up alongside my high school sweetheart has been one of the greatest gifts of my life.
Family means everything to me. No matter what else I accomplish, these four will always come first.
